name: Kelvin J Lawrence

items.text: In July 2024, Lawrence was arrested and indicted on two felony counts: second-degree forgery and possessing a forged instrument. The indictment alleges he falsified a builder's license with intent to defraud. He pleaded not guilty on July 26, 2024. The most recent report found (January 2025) still showed the case pending. No verdict was found.
items.why: A serious unresolved charge of forging a license, which bears on abuse of office or dishonesty (criterion 6), is pending with no court finding, so it is shown but doesn't count.

for_review: Check the current status of the Lowndes County case (45-CC-2024-000101). Wikipedia's 'List of 2020s American state and local politicians convicted of crimes' lists Lawrence as 'convicted of forgery'. I found no news report or court record backing that. His Wikipedia page doesn't say it either, and Ballotpedia (read Nov 2026) lists him as a sitting member on the Nov 2026 ballot with only the 2024 arrest and not-guilty plea. If a conviction or plea is confirmed in court records, this item would become 'against' (probably weight 3, since it concerns forging a license). I could not reach the indictment PDF or an Alabama court docket. The newest news on the case that I read was from January 2025. The one search on the owner's named sites (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) turned up nothing about Lawrence.
